# Precision Practice Management

> > Precision Practice Management delivers comprehensive medical billing, RCM, EHR implementation, and healthcare IT solutions powered by AI and RPA technology.

Precision Practice Management (PPM) is a healthcare services firm specializing in revenue cycle management, medical billing, and practice management solutions for hospitals, physician practices, and health systems. The company leverages AI, machine learning, and RPA technologies to optimize billing operations, improve reimbursement, and streamline healthcare workflows.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing & Coding
- EHR Implementation & Optimization
- AI & Machine Learning
- RPA (Robotic Process Automation)
- Practice Management Software
- Credentialing & Contracting
- Inpatient Part A RCM
- Outpatient Part B RCM
- Charge Capture Systems
- Medicare Compliance (MIPS/MACRA)
- Accounts Receivable Management
- Healthcare IT Solutions
- Meaningful Use Compliance
- Revenue Leakage Prevention

## Core Services

- [Revenue Cycle Management Solutions](https://www.precisionpractice.com/revenue-cycle-management-solutions-services.html): Comprehensive RCM services including credentialing, coding, AR, and EHR implementation
- [Inpatient Part A RCM](https://www.precisionpractice.com/inpatient-part-a-rcm.html): Inpatient Part A RCM with AI, machine learning, and RPA technology
- [Outpatient Part B RCM](https://www.precisionpractice.com/outpatient-part-b-rcm.html): Outpatient Part B RCM combining AI, RPA, and revenue cycle expertise
- [Hospital Charge Capture Services](https://www.precisionpractice.com/hospital-charge-capture-services.html): Hospital charge capture systems, training, and RCM support
- [Contracting & Credentialing Services](https://www.precisionpractice.com/hospital-physician-credentialing-services.html): Physician and hospital credentialing and contracting services
- [RCM for Independent Physician Associations](https://www.precisionpractice.com/revenue-cycle-management-independent-physician-associations.html): RCM and billing services tailored for independent physician associations
